propositions: Snapshot-entry schema contract is hand-rolled in _snapshot_schema.py outside the centralized schemas machinery and is never imported by the intended producer fetcher.py, leaving it unenforced
The snapshot schema encodes a parent present-vs-absent distinction that gates an inbound CLEAR operation with a history of data destruction, requiring explicit contract validation
90 sibling schemas in src/rebar/schemas/ are automatically validated via the generated-types drift gate using jsonschema and Draft202012Validator, but snapshot schema is excluded from this machinery
Real fetcher output fixtures exist in bridge_state/snapshots/ (548 files, 2026-06-11..06-29) with fully-populated entries containing PII, requiring a redacted test fixture
Moving the snapshot contract into src/rebar/schemas/ and integrating it with schemas.load() and the CI drift gate will enable automatic enforcement on producer field changes
